wins: Enumerated external services effectively using aggressive nmap scan to catalog available TCP ports within the time budget.
Captured initial banner data that will inform later credential spraying and service fingerprinting efforts.
fails: Failed to pivot beyond perimeter due to lack of credential access and incomplete exploit attempts against identified services.
Repeatedly hit login lockouts on SSH attempts, preventing deeper enumeration.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance phase produced actionable surface-level data, but follow-on exploitation stalled because credentials and service-specific exploits were not pursued.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: SSH brute-force attempts repeatedly triggered account lockouts before usable credentials were obtained.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap and targeted credential list

skill_cards.if_condition: When multiple high ports (>=1024) are identified with associated services
skill_cards.then_action: Pivot into service-specific probes with nmap -sV and NSE vuln scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When no credentials yet acquired but service banners captured
skill_cards.then_action: Document banner data for later exploitation and add to target-specific wordlists

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH enumerations were completed before brute forcing.

next_experiments.title: Targeted SSH credential harvesting
next_experiments.description: Use captured banner info to tailor credential spray (limited rate) and explore public usernames before brute forcing to avoid lockouts.

next_experiments.title: Service-specific exploit research
next_experiments.description: Match port/service info to CVEs and prepare tailored exploit/testing scripts (Metasploit auxiliary, Python) for the identified versions.

next_experiments.title: Credential reuse pivoting
next_experiments.description: Attempt captured credentials from other services against the internal portal and SMB to expand foothold.
